messages.content: I keep ordering one more coffee every morning

Is there a sense of justification or rationalization happening when you decide to order that one more coffee, similar to what you mentioned earlier: "I know I shouldn't do it, I'm going to do it. Tomorrow will be easier to quit because I have fed the wolf today"? 

As mentioned in [own-tension] tension coffee-addiction, "I think this is the beautiful part: I know I shouldn't do it, I'm going to do it." (tensions/coffee-addiction.md)
